description: A fresh cut imported 06-001, 06-003 and 06-076 in order and showed next-number 77, and an untagged cut halted at stamp. A later cut with duplicate 06-001 identities nevertheless ran through self-check, fence and scoring instead of halting; the direct command to seed a retired identity also returned -32601.
